name: Dawnspike Spear
description: A leaf-shaped ash spear tipped with warm brass and a narrow sunstone groove. Its honey-coloured haft is wrapped in blue linen, while tiny runes along the socket brighten at first light.

name: Glasswind Dagger
description: A slim sea-green blade of enchanted glass, clear at the edges and clouded like a storm at the centre. The silver pommel holds a feather-shaped charm that never stops trembling.

name: Cinderwake Hatchet
description: A practical iron hatchet with a charcoal-black head and a red-brown ironbark handle. Three copper studs balance the grip, and its leather loop is sturdy enough for a travelling belt.

name: Moonfang Scimitar
description: This curved, blue-steel scimitar catches light in a silver crescent along its edge. The ivory grip is carved with sleeping wolves and capped by a smoky quartz pommel.

name: Thornroot Longbow
description: Dark yew limbs twist around living green thorns without drawing blood from the hand. Its pale flax bowstring is fitted with a small amber nocking bead and a matching moss-green case.

name: Frostbell Mace
description: A compact steel mace with a bell-shaped head glazed in icy blue enamel. Frost gathers in the engraved valleys after sunset, and the wrapped birch handle stays pleasantly warm.

name: Starfall Rapier
description: A needle-fine rapier forged from midnight metal, crossed by a bright line of fallen star iron. Its basket hilt is silver wire around a violet crystal that glimmers when danger approaches.

name: Gravebell Flail
description: Three blackened iron bells hang from a braided chain beneath a bone-white grip. They make no sound in motion, but each bell carries a tiny tarnished nameplate from an old border shrine.

name: Riverglass Trident
description: A three-pronged bronze trident with translucent turquoise blades, polished smooth as river stones. A braided teal cord at the haft smells faintly of rain and keeps its colour in salt water.

name: Ashen Comet Chakram
description: A balanced throwing ring of dark steel, its rim chased with copper sparks and its centre inlaid with a smoky orange agate. The flat black case has a red silk lining and a magnetic clasp.

name: Whisper Reed Blowpipe
description: A lacquered reed blowpipe striped in cream and fern green, light enough for a scout's pack. Its carved mouthpiece is shaped like a curled leaf and comes with a felt dart roll.

name: Kingsroad Warhammer
description: A broad-headed warhammer of brushed iron with a polished brass collar and a weathered oak haft. The head bears a small road-map engraving, each crossroads picked out in dark blue enamel.

name: Sunken Crown Cutlass
description: A sea-worn cutlass with a green-bronze guard and a blue-grey blade flecked like drowned stars. Its handle is wrapped in cream sailcloth and sealed with a tiny pearl button.

name: Emberthread Crossbow
description: Redwood limbs frame a compact crossbow strung with a glowing copper filament. The dark walnut stock has a brass sunburst plate, and heat-red runes pulse beside the trigger.

name: Silverthorn Kris
description: A legendary wave-bladed kris made from silversteel, with thorn-shaped ridges that catch a cold white shine. Its black jade handle is set with a single green stone said to remember every oath.

name: Cloudbreak Staff
description: A pale ash staff crowned by a ring of floating blue glass shards. White cord wraps the lower third, and a silver weather vane at the tip turns toward the nearest storm.

name: Briarhook Sickle
description: A crescent sickle with a leaf-green steel blade and a walnut handle carved into a thorny branch. Its stitched russet sheath has a loop for a gardener's belt or a ranger's sash.

name: Obsidian Sunblade
description: A straight blade of glossy obsidian edged in molten gold, with a warm radiance trapped beneath the black surface. The amber hilt is wrapped in white hide and finished with a red garnet seal.

name: Copperleaf Buckler
description: A small round buckler faced with layered maple and painted a rich copper green. Its central boss is hammered brass, while a soft russet grip and wool-lined rim keep it comfortable.

name: Bastion Scale Vest
description: Overlapping iron scales form a flexible vest beneath charcoal canvas shoulders. Each scale is edged in dull silver, and the side laces are blue leather with heavy bronze toggles.

name: Mossguard Helm
description: A forest-green steel helm with a low brow and a crest of preserved moss. The inside is lined with cream felt, and small brass antlers curl back from the temples.

name: Hearthward Kite Shield
description: A tall kite shield painted brick red, with a golden hearth emblem set over warm cedar planks. The reverse has a wool hand strap and a pocket for a folded charm banner.

name: Glacierplate Greaves
description: Pair of articulated greaves forged from pale blue alloy, each joint lined with white leather. Frosty geometric etching travels from the knee to a faceted silver heel guard.

name: Ravenmail Coif
description: Fine black rings of raven-dark steel form a close-fitting coif with a soft plum-coloured lining. A single onyx bead rests at the throat, hidden beneath a discreet leather tie.

name: Sunscale Bracers
description: Bracers of overlapping brass scales, polished until they glow like late afternoon. The inner cuffs are crimson suede, and tiny blue enamel suns mark each fastening stud.

name: Gloamsteel Cuirass
description: A fitted cuirass of violet-black steel with a subtle oil-slick sheen. Its breastplate carries a dim constellation in silver wire, backed by burgundy quilted padding.

name: Thistledown Armguards
description: Light canvas armguards quilted with soft thistledown and dyed sage green. Reinforced tan leather panels protect the wrists, while wooden toggles make them quick to adjust.

name: Ironroot Tower Shield
description: A massive shield built from dark ironwood around a black iron rim, with roots carved branching over its face. A deep blue boss holds an old silver coin at its centre.

name: Sablehorn Pauldrons
description: Asymmetrical pauldrons of smoked steel, one crowned with a polished black horn and the other with three smaller ridges. Deep violet straps and wool padding soften the silhouette.

name: Amberwatch Buckler
description: A travel buckler faced in honey-coloured lacquer over layered birch. Its rim is dark bronze, and a thumb-sized amber window glows gently whenever a hidden door is nearby.

name: Wyrmhide Harness
description: A supple harness cut from rust-red wyrmhide, stitched with black thread and fitted with eight brushed-steel rings. Its shoulder plates show faint natural scales rather than painted decoration.

name: Kingsglass Visor
description: A narrow visor of smoky crystal set in a silver brow frame, giving the wearer a clear view while hiding the eyes behind a dusky sheen. Blue velvet pads protect the temples.

name: Fallowfield Leathercoat
description: A weatherproof coat of chestnut leather with a moss-coloured wool collar and roomy inner pockets. Its brass buckles are deliberately plain, made for long roads rather than ceremonies.

name: Pearlsteel Gauntlets
description: Articulated gauntlets forged from a pale alloy that gleams like pearl beneath water. Rose-gold seams frame the fingers, and a tiny turquoise stone sits in each wrist clasp.

name: Dragonwake Warplate
description: A ceremonial suit of deep crimson plate with blackened edges and a scaled collar. Gold lines trace the shape of unfurling wings, and the inner silk is midnight blue with red stitching.

name: Willowmist Cloak
description: A generous grey-green cloak woven from brushed wool, with a pale lining patterned like drifting willow leaves. The hood is weighted with two wooden beads so it sits neatly in wind.

name: Aurora Thread Tunic
description: Soft teal linen is embroidered with threads that shift from pink to gold as the wearer moves. A narrow cream collar and pearl buttons keep its bright colours refined rather than loud.

name: Foxfire Traveller Boots
description: Knee-high boots in russet leather, with charcoal soles and orange stitching shaped like little flames. A fox-red lining and hidden heel pockets make them equally useful on trail or street.

name: Cloudlinen Scholar Robe
description: An airy ivory robe of cloud-soft linen, edged in slate-blue piping and fastened with six carved bone buttons. The generous sleeves are lined in silver-grey cloth for a quiet shimmer.

name: Verdigris Ranger Mantle
description: A hooded mantle of waxed forest canvas, coloured like old copper with darker green folds. Its shoulder cape is lined in tawny fleece and closes with a hand-cast leaf clasp.

name: Rosefire Masquerade Coat
description: A tailored wine-red coat with black velvet lapels and a lining printed with tiny gold flames. Its cuffs carry rose-coloured glass buttons, each one reflecting a different warm hue.

name: Nightbloom Silk Dress
description: Deep indigo silk falls in quiet layers, scattered with embroidered flowers in violet, silver, and midnight blue. A narrow waist sash is finished with a moonstone-coloured tassel.

name: Hearthfox Wool Scarf
description: A thick rust-and-cream wool scarf with a soft brushed nap and fringed ends. The repeating fox pattern is woven rather than printed, so the colours remain bright after many winters.

name: Sapphire Tide Trousers
description: Hard-wearing navy trousers cut from flexible sailcloth, with bright sapphire stitching and roomy cargo pockets. A sea-green waistband braid gives them a neat finish without restricting movement.

name: Mothwing Evening Cape
description: A smoky plum cape with a scalloped hem and a velvet surface that catches light like moth wings. Pale copper embroidery traces the collar, secured by a faceted amber clasp.

name: Briarweave Apron
description: Sturdy olive canvas protects the front of this artisan apron, while tan leather pockets hold tools, herbs, or a handful of coins. Red thread makes a small berry pattern along the hem.

name: Gilded Sun Hat
description: A broad straw hat dyed warm cream, bound with a golden ribbon and a spray of dried yellow flowers. The brim is lightly enchanted to stay crisp even after a sudden shower.

name: Frostpetal Mittens
description: Plush white mittens embroidered with blue frostpetal shapes and lined in soft grey rabbit-free fleece. A silver thread at each cuff gives off a faint cool sparkle in moonlight.

name: Griffincrest Tabard
description: A formal tabard of midnight wool, split for riding and bordered in antique gold braid. A proud blue-and-white griffin is appliqued across the chest with unusually fine feather detail.

name: Larkspur Raincloak
description: Water-shedding charcoal cloth is lined with lavender cotton and finished with a row of lilac ceramic toggles. The roomy hood has a small stiffened peak that keeps rain from the eyes.

name: Royal Azure Surcoat
description: A long azure surcoat woven with deep blue silk and silver metallic thread, cut for a graceful sweep over armour. Its collar carries a hand-embroidered white crown surrounded by tiny stars.

name: Emberlace Dancing Shoes
description: Soft black dance shoes are crossed with ember-orange laces that glow just before music begins. The soles are flexible crimson leather, and each heel contains a quiet brass bell.

name: Whispering Moon Ring
description: A slender silver ring surrounds a milky moonstone whose blue centre drifts like a cloud. The inside band is engraved with a barely audible lullaby in an unknown script.

name: Compass of Seven Roads
description: A brass compass in a dark walnut case, with seven coloured needles instead of one. Its cream face shows tiny landmarks rather than numbers, and the lid is inlaid with green aventurine.

name: Ravenfeather Brooch
description: Three black feathers are captured in a silver frame with a blue enamel eye at the centre. The pin back is hidden behind a small felt guard, making it safe for cloaks and fine collars.

name: Sunstone Hairpin Set
description: A pair of slender brass hairpins topped with polished orange sunstone beads. Their warm colour suits both dark braids and pale hair, and the ridged tips hold without tugging.

name: Tidecaller Shell Necklace
description: A spiral pearl shell hangs from a braided navy cord threaded with tiny sea-glass beads. The shell's pink interior holds a soft blue gleam that brightens near moving water.

name: Gilded Thorn Circlet
description: Fine gold branches curl into a light circlet, each thorn tipped with a dark red garnet. The inner band is lined with green velvet so the elaborate crown remains comfortable for long ceremonies.

name: Pocketsized Familiar Bell
description: A tiny bronze bell with a blue ribbon and a silver clapper, sized for a satchel or animal collar. It rings only for its chosen companion and leaves a faint note in the air.

name: Lapis Signet of Oaths
description: A heavy silver signet carries a deep lapis oval engraved with a balanced scale. Its shoulders are chased with tiny white lines, and the stone has a smooth, cool weight in the hand.

name: Faefern Satchel
description: A compact moss-green satchel of waxed canvas, trimmed in cream leather and patterned with pressed fern shapes. Its inside pocket is lined in copper-orange silk and always feels a little larger inside.

name: Sundial Cufflinks
description: Two round brass cufflinks show miniature sundials beneath clear glass. Dark teal enamel marks the cardinal points, and the hinged backs are sturdy enough for everyday shirts.

name: Amethyst Dream Locket
description: A teardrop locket of silver and violet amethyst opens on a moon-shaped hinge. The interior has a pale satin recess for a keepsake and glows softly while its owner sleeps.

name: Cindercoin Charm Strand
description: Five old copper coins hang from a braided black cord, each stamped with a different tiny flame. The coins are worn smooth at the edges and make a gentle, reassuring clink.

name: Opal Orchard Comb
description: A polished pearwood comb has teeth tipped with small milky opals that flash green, rose, and blue. Carved apple blossoms cover the handle and feel warm after it is worn.

name: Stormglass Monocle
description: A single smoky lens sits in a delicate silver frame with a navy silk cord. Pale lightning threads drift across the glass, revealing hidden ink without dimming ordinary text.

name: Redthread Friendship Bracelet
description: Braided scarlet thread is knotted around three tiny wooden beads, each painted cream, blue, or green. It is simple, light, and finished with a sliding knot for any wrist.

name: Crown of Quiet Stars
description: A delicate crown of pale silver arcs carries nine tiny star sapphires, each lit by a different blue-white point. The narrow inner band is velvet-lined and almost weightless when worn.

name: Brightroot Healing Draught
description: A ruby-red tonic in a squat clear bottle, layered with golden brightroot and a sprig of mint. The cork is sealed in green wax, and the label bears a cheerful painted sun.

name: Moonmilk Sleep Elixir
description: Opalescent white liquid swirls with lavender ribbons inside a blue glass vial. Dried jasmine floats near the stopper, whose silver thread seal smells faintly of rain.

name: Emberpepper Fire Tonic
description: A bright orange tonic flecked with red pepper and suspended sparks. It comes in a heatproof brown bottle with a black cap and a label illustrated with a grinning salamander.

name: Frostbloom Antidote
description: Clear liquid surrounds a single blue-white frostbloom in a faceted glass ampoule. The stopper is wrapped in white thread, and the paper label is stamped with a silver snowflake.

name: Verdant Giant's Tonic
description: A thick green tonic glows around crushed fern, pearly seeds, and a curl of vine. Its broad square bottle is sealed with brown resin and wears a hand-painted leaf medallion.

name: Starling Focus Phial
description: A slender violet phial contains a dark liquid crossed by quick silver motes. Its cork is topped with a tiny brass starling, and the indigo label is edged in crisp white ink.

name: Seaglass Breath Potion
description: A turquoise potion bubbles gently in a round sea-green bottle, with a pearl floating at its centre. The stopper is pale cork wrapped in blue twine and decorated with a shell chip.

name: Goldleaf Fortune Syrup
description: Honey-gold syrup clings to the sides of an angular amber bottle, carrying real flakes of goldleaf. A green silk ribbon seals the neck beneath a small four-leaf wax stamp.

name: Ashen Veil Smoke Vial
description: A black glass vial holds silver-grey smoke that curls against the stopper without escaping. Its red wax seal bears a closed eye, and a charcoal label explains the careful uncorking ritual.

name: Petalheart Restoration Tea
description: A rose-coloured loose tea is packed in a cream tin with a pressed-flower lid. Hibiscus, cinnamon bark, and tiny pink petals give the blend a bright scent and a gentle warmth.

name: Thunderroot Adrenal Draught
description: Electric blue liquid snaps with harmless sparks in a heavy clear bottle. The label is yellow with black lightning marks, and the metal cap is padded with a strip of red leather.

name: Wyrmfruit Vitality Cordial
description: A coral-red cordial with a sweet berry scent, bottled in green glass and sealed with a copper cap. A dried crimson fruit hangs from the neck on a short natural-fibre cord.

name: Mirrorwater Truth Tonic
description: Perfectly clear tonic rests in a mirror-polished silver flask, reflecting the drinker's face without distortion. A narrow blue ribbon and a white wax seal mark the carefully measured dose.

name: Lavender Lantern Oil
description: Pale purple lamp oil fills a squat ceramic bottle painted with tiny gold lanterns. It burns with a clean violet flame and leaves a soft lavender scent on the hands.

name: Cometwake Revival Ampoule
description: A narrow crystal ampoule contains dark blue liquid threaded with a brilliant white streak. Its platinum cap is etched with a comet trail, and the glass is cushioned in midnight velvet.

name: Quietgarden Purifying Mist
description: A fine silver mist rests in a green atomiser bottle decorated with white gardenias. The glass nozzle is protected by a wooden cap, and the contents smell of crushed leaves after rain.

name: Clockwork Griffin
description: A palm-sized brass griffin with blue enamel wings and a ruby-red eye, assembled from visible gears and fine springs. Its tail feathers click softly as it walks across a table.

name: Lantern of Gentle Roads
description: An old iron lantern with amber glass panels, each painted with a different winding road. Its oak handle is worn smooth, and the flame inside leans toward safe shelter after dusk.

name: Memory Pearl Vial
description: A round glass vial cradles a luminous pearl suspended in clear water. The stopper is mother-of-pearl, and the tiny blue label is blank until someone whispers a memory beside it.

name: Brambleheart Music Box
description: A walnut music box is carved with curling brambles and lined in crimson felt. When opened, its silver cylinder plays a slow woodland melody while a tiny brass bird turns.

name: Astral Orrery Sphere
description: A dark blue sphere rests in concentric silver rings, showing moving constellations beneath its polished surface. Gold pins mark old stars, and the walnut stand has three clawed feet.

name: Rootbound Grimoire
description: Thick cream pages are bound in green leather and clasped with a living root that has become polished wood. The cover bears a copper leaf, while the ink inside changes from black to moss green.

name: Chime of Returning Dawn
description: A small silver chime hangs from a red cord and carries a sunrise engraved around its rim. Its clear note lingers unusually long, fading into the colour of pale morning light.

name: Obsidian Scrying Bowl
description: A low bowl of black volcanic glass has a mirror-smooth interior and a rim flecked with silver. Three small brass feet lift it from the table, each shaped like a curled serpent.

name: Fae Doorway Key
description: An oversized pewter key has a pale green crystal set into its bow and a stem etched with tiny vines. Its teeth never match the same lock twice, but always feel warm near hidden hinges.

name: Sundering Map Case
description: A cylindrical map case of navy leather is banded with copper and capped by two cream ivory-coloured discs. The interior is dry and cool, and its strap carries a stitched mountain range.

name: Heartwood Seed Reliquary
description: A small reliquary carved from reddish heartwood contains one pale seed behind a round crystal window. Gold leaf fills its leaf-shaped cracks, and a green cord secures the hinged lid.

name: Crownless King's Coin
description: A heavy black-gold coin bears the profile of a king whose crown has been deliberately scratched away. Its edge carries a ring of tiny stars, and it feels warm when held by a stranger.

name: The Hollow Hourglass
description: This narrow hourglass has violet glass bulbs and a frame of tarnished silver branches. Instead of sand, weightless black motes rise from the lower chamber and vanish at the neck.

name: Rainmaker's Copper Horn
description: A curled copper horn has a blue enamel mouthpiece and a handle wrapped in storm-grey cord. Its bell is engraved with clouds, raindrops, and a little green valley.

name: Veil of the First Cartographer
description: A folded veil of midnight silk is embroidered with gold coastlines and tiny red compass roses. When spread on a table, the pattern shifts to show the nearest road through unknown country.

name: The Last Blue Flame
description: A clear crystal lantern contains a single blue flame that casts no heat but paints nearby metal with silver light. Its base is white marble, ringed with seven tiny brass stars.
